requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 600. The capacity of 45 children is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class (D or better) and proximity to green spaces are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents.
The user wants the building to be located near green spaces. Per the data distribution, 'near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green column (74.26), rounded to 74.

Energy class D or better, so any class from A1 to D is accepted. Classes E, F and G are excluded. The 600 sqm floor area, 45-child capacity and proximity to green spaces are not energy requirements and are not filtered here.

output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (property_type 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 600, energy_class from A1 to D, and green score >= 74, restricted to a 3.0 km radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892 via haversine_km on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance ascending. The capacity requirement (45 children) has no matching column and is not applied.
